attribution_requirements.current_v1_page_wording: English definition source: Open English WordNet 2025, CC BY 4.0. Bangla explanation and examples adapted and written for Ovidhan.
attribution_requirements.editorial_boundary: Only definition text and sense identity come from OEWN. Bangla meanings, explanations and bilingual examples are Ovidhan editorial work and are labelled as such in every record.
attribution_requirements.required_on_pages_deriving_definitions: Name Open English WordNet 2025, link to https://en-word.net/, state the license CC BY 4.0 with link to https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/.

committed_in_repository: Only the compact synset lock (dictionary-v2/oewn-2025-synset-lock.json). The full OEWN archive and extracted data files are NOT committed.
extraction_and_lock_procedure: 1. Download english-wordnet-2025.zip from the OEWN downloads page and keep it outside the repository (for example in a Downloads folder).

2. Run: node scripts/dictionary-v2/build-oewn-lock.js --archive <path-to-zip>. The tool first verifies the archive SHA-256 and size against this file, then verifies the SHA-256 and size of every archive member listed under "files". Any mismatch aborts with a non-zero exit code and nothing is written.
3. The tool parses data.noun, data.verb, data.adj and data.adv and writes the compact lock for exactly the synset ids referenced by dictionary-v2/records/*.json.
4. To check that the committed lock is still exact, run the same command with --check (writes nothing, fails on any difference).

5. Instead of the archive, an already extracted directory may be supplied with --oewn-dir <dir>; each member file is then verified by SHA-256 and size, but the archive hash itself cannot be verified in that mode.

6. Day-to-day validation (scripts/dictionary-v2/validate.js) runs offline against the committed lock; add --archive or --oewn-dir to additionally re-derive and compare every locked synset from the real source.
